lines.text: The sound of a TV drifts through the dark room.
*Bum, bum-ba-bum*
Grand music swells as a stylishly dressed female hero appears on the TV.

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Hahaha! The hero has arrived!

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Let's go, fellow heroes!

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Onwards!
The girl's eyes sparkle as she stares at the TV, spellbound.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Onwards...!

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Evil, come forth!

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: No matter what torment you inflict on others,

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: so long as I, the Ultra Hero, still stand,

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: hope will never be extinguished!

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Justice shall never be defeated!
The girl makes small flailing motions with her arms.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Never be defeated...!

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Hyaaaaaah!
*Whoosh* *Pow!* *Crash!* *Bang!*
Once the Ultra Hero has defeated every last Rapture fiend,
she stands tall before the camera.

lines.speaker: supergreathero
lines.text: Another victory for the heroes!
The girl's eyes light up at the sight.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Whoa...! So cool...
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What... why's it so dark in here...?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Huh? Aaaah!
*Thud* *Crash*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Gah! You scared me!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Owww... my knee hurts...

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Wh-what the heck?! Why did you barge in without knocking?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What are you even talking about?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: This is my lab! You're the one who broke in.
Maxwell glances at the TV screen.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You know, you don't have to hide the fact that you're watching that.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: There's nothing wrong with a kid liking superhero movies.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I-I don't like that stuff! And I'm not a kid!
*Beep*
The girl quickly switches channels.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Right... Is that why you ditched that fancy room of yours? So you could watch this in here?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Th-that's...!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... Father doesn't approve of this.
Syuen shrinks back deep into the sofa.
*Pat*
Maxwell roughly ruffles Syuen's hair.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Hey! What the...?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Don't start scrunching up your face and scowling already.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Keep that up and you'll never grow any taller.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Who says I won't?! I'm gonna grow super tall!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Father's really tall, and so is...

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: A-anyway! I'm gonna grow taller!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Ah... Is that so?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm sure you're going to grow nice and tall, little Syuen. Now, this grown-up has work to do, so why don't you see yourself out?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Believe it or not, I'm actually a pretty capable researcher.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I've got research to conduct!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: You... you only work here because Father pays you!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Oh, really now?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I-I'm his daughter, a-and the rightful heir to Missilis!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: There's no where in Missilis I can't go!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Is that right?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: My employment contract is strictly with Missilis Industry.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Babysitting little pipsqueaks like you isn't in the fine print.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Besides, heir or not, the only one with clearance to go anywhere inside Missilis is the CEO. Got it?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: *Sigh* I never should've set foot in that break room that day...

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Do you... regret meeting me?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Am I... not welcome here anymore?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Do I have to leave?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: *Sigh* Fine. Just sit there quietly and watch your TV.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Tch... I knew you were gonna let me stay...! I'm hungry!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Ugh, you cheeky little...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: There are some snacks over there. Help yourself.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I'm gonna eat them even without your permission!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Eat up. That's how you'll grow taller.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I WILL grow up tall! Just as tall as Father!
*Crunch*
Syuen pops a cookie into her mouth.
*Beep, beep*
She resumes flipping through the channels.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Quit switching channels and just watch one of those superhero movies you like so much.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I told you, I don't like them!
Syuen quickly changes the channel.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I like watching the news...

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Following the failure of the Second Surface Reclamation War,

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: the Central Government has stated that the Big Three also bear a share of the responsibility.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Citing the steady decline of Missilis Industry's Nikke development technology as a primary cause,

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: they announced they will lodge a formal protest with Missilis CEO Enme.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: While there is widespread acknowledgment of Enme's accomplishments, the public has also voiced criticism that his direction for Nikke development no longer aligns with the Ark's future.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Wh-what are they saying...?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Father's being criticized? Why?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Don't pay it any mind.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's just the Central Government pinning the blame on others, same as always.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Pinning the blame on others?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You know the Second Surface Reclamation War ended in failure, right?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Yeah. I heard... a whole lot of Nikkes from our company died too.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You know your stuff.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: At first, they pointed fingers at the executive commander, New Hope.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: After he bailed,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: they needed someone else to sick their teeth in, refusing to take responsibility until the very end.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Can't have public opinion turning against them, after all.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: But why blame us for it?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Because ever since we entered the Ark, Missilis hasn't put out a single high-performance Nikke.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You do know the original technology to manufacture Nikkes belongs to our company, right?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Yeah, I knew that.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I heard Grandmother was the one who developed it!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That's right. Your grandmother, the first CEO, created the prototype for every Nikke.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: After that, she went on to develop the Grimms model Nikkes as a minor variant.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Then, once she'd established the production methods for mass-produced Nikkes and Nikkes with unique designs,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: she handed the reins over to your father, the second CEO, and devoted herself to research.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: From what I've heard, up until we entered the Ark, they kept researching that technology under the leadership of the Central Government and poured everything into boosting the Nikkes' performance.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But after we took refuge in the Ark,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: President Enme threw his weight behind the telecom industry instead of advancing Nikkes. Nikke technology practically stopped progressing altogether.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That's exactly what those guys want to use against us.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: They claim the Second Surface Reclamation War failed because the Nikkes weren't powerful enough.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That's the reason there's been no Nikke advancement since we entered the Ark.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's because Missilis won't reveal the original Nikke-manufacturing technology. Or at least that's how they want to frame it.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: *Munch, munch* Why would they do that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If they win the PR battle, they can dump more of the responsibility onto Missilis.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And even if it fails, they might still be able to get their hands on the original Nikke blueprints...
*Crunch*
Syuen munches on a sweet biscuit.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Wh-what? Keep going.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Never mind. What am I doing, telling all this to a kid...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: At any rate, you don't need to worry about it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: This is your father we're talking about. You think something like this would even make him bat an eye?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Looks to me like the Central Government's losing it with all these problems bubbling up one after another.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Once they come to their senses, they're the ones who'll be sorry.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Missilis will never fall.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... Well, that's good.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So how about you stop racking that little brain of yours and focus on eating well so you grow up big and strong, eh?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Worrying too much will stunt your growth.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Argh! Why do you keep harping on my height!
*Knock, knock*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hmm? Who could that be at this hour?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Is anyone in?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yes. Come in.
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Pardon the intrusion.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Father's been asking for you, Maxwell.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The boss? Right now?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Yes. He said to come to the CEO's office.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Oh... All right.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: By the way! Oh! I was wondering where my little cutie had wandered off to.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: So this is where you were.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Since Maxwell has to go see Father, why don't you come along with me, sweetie?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... No. I'm not going.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Sweetie. Don't you think it's rude to linger in someone's lab when they're not around?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: If Father were to find out, he'd be alarmed.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... Fine, I'll go!
Syuen climbs down from the sofa and trudges off.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hey, pipsqueak.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'll stock up on snacks, so stop by again sometime.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... Okay!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: See you next time!
Syuen and Jien leave.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That unsettling air about her... she's exactly like her father, isn't she?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: No wonder Syuen's so spooked and can't stand her.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: How's Syuen ever supposed to go up against that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The next successor's bound to be Jien... But what'll become of Syuen?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Ah, forget it. What's the point in worrying?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: At any rate, that pipsqueak's life will still turn out better than a working stiff like me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Oh well, time to get back to work.
